description: P0.3: half_twice fires a real extra half-power attack (fresh calcDamage, own crit/variance rolls) every round the attacker's main hit connects -- `_halfTwiceUsed` is reset each round for that round's active attacker (bundle.deobfuscated.js:55430-55431), so despite the name it is NOT a battle-lifetime flag; this fixture's 14 rounds each get their own extra hit. Gen1 so ability_config/traits_config are both null -- isolates the raw extra-attack damage/RNG mechanic from any hook re-entry.
